scripts.build: npm run config:local && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.build:deploy: npm run config:deploy && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.deploy:remote: npm run verify:v3-deployment && npm run internal:db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.db:migrate:local: npm run config:local && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config .wrangler/deploy.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npm run verify:v3-deployment && npm run internal:db:migrate:remote
scripts.internal:db:migrate:remote: npm run config:deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config .wrangler/deploy.jsonc
scripts.test:reference-foundation: vitest run worker/reference-target-schema.test.ts worker/reference-resolver.test.ts worker/reference-registry.test.ts worker/reference-routes.test.ts worker/reference-media-route.test.ts worker/reference-foundation-consistency.test.ts worker/reference-destinations.test.ts worker/reference-search.test.ts worker/reference-search-boundaries.test.ts worker/reference-search-routes.test.ts worker/reference-search-consistency.test.ts src/reference-page.test.ts src/reference-search-page.test.ts src/lib/reference-search-ui.test.ts src/reference-source-focus.test.ts src/reference-source-integration.test.ts worker/media-response.test.ts && npm run test:reference-mounted
scripts.verify:blob-lifecycle: npm run test:blob-lifecycle && npm run verify:d1-migrations
scripts.verify:reference-foundation: npm run test:reference-foundation && npm run verify:d1-migrations && npm run verify:reference-worker && npm run verify:reference-search-worker
scripts.verify:v3-deployment: npm run test:blob-lifecycle && npm run test:reference-foundation && npm run verify:d1-migrations && npm run verify:reference-worker && npm run verify:reference-search-worker && npm test && npm run build:deploy
